preservedOriginalEpisode03Proposal.title: The cellblock bet
preservedOriginalEpisode03Proposal.summary: Three cunning inmates develop a private competitive wager about drawing the confident Inspector Shreya into repeated conversation. They exploit her desire to solve difficult challenges, making each legitimate interaction an ego test, but she initially remains unaware of their bet. No date or future physical contact is locked.
beats: Shreya's competitive pride drives her to investigate their puzzle/challenge and can eventually cause her to lose a nonsexual wager.

A temporary, voluntary obligation to hear their explanation or respond to a legitimate authorized question, without compromising legal procedure or removing her ability to refuse. She is never required to obey personal or sexual demands.

Repeated dialogue, escalating psychological competition and a possible future attraction may be planned later; any intimacy must be freely chosen, not punishment for losing, and not part of a custody quid pro quo.
